# Registry of the named security regression tests in docs/12-testing-and-quality.md
# ("Security testing"), checked by check-security-tests.sh (D61). One line per test:
#   <test> <status> <slice> <issue> <note …>
# status: pending (its slice is not merged yet; an area's design slice registers its tests),
# done (exists in a _test.go file), p2 or p3 (a later phase, or an area not designed yet). The
# PR that implements a test changes pending to done. The note names clauses that other slices or
# later phases add.
